assertions.name: setting the goal alone performs no prompt dispatch
overlapping idle events use one in-flight dispatch per session
goal requests shared async deferred dispatcher with 150 ms settle
paused goal does not dispatch on idle
resumed active goal dispatches on next idle
native before-command Fixture objective mutates only local mocked goal state
native before-command pause mutates only local mocked goal state
native before-command resume mutates only local mocked goal state
empty goal argument preserves objective for show
goal hook alone does not pause on quota/error event
goal hook alone does not back off after dispatcher failures

limitations: Controller store is an in-memory stub; production filesystem persistence not exercised.
Dispatcher is a deterministic stub; production status/tool gate not exercised.
Native before-command handler is tested; OpenCode subsequent command/provider pipeline is not exercised.
This is neither live client qualification nor scheduler/quota-stop qualification.
